name: Ted
source:
Likes: Basking in the sun, fish
Dislikes: Dogs, anything related to onions, chocolate
Hobbies: Grooming, observing magical creatures
Skills: Manual labor

"I have to protect the woman I love even if it kills me."

Gray: Ted is a new student who entered the academy.
He's Gedonelune's first Beastman, and a powerful one at that.
He's knowledgeable about Magical Creature Biology, so feel free to ask him any questions if you're curious. I also asked him many things, and he's a great guy once he starts talking. It would be nice if he could get along with everyone else in the academy, too.
But he seems to be looking for something and is always looking at the forest.
I wonder what he's so curious about?

[Official in-game description]
